fusions.name: Roundshot
fusions.desc: Fires a cold iron ball that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring armour.

fusions.name: Grapeshot
fusions.desc: Blasts a spray of iron shot in a cone 5 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to each enemy caught. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Behind the Mantlet
fusions.desc: Plants an iron mantlet that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds, raising your armour by 6% while it holds. A gun crew fires from behind it for 10 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Drilled Reloading
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and every ability you have comes round 6% sooner.
